title: Equipment — Aft Cargo Compartment — Brushless Drive Units and Short-Pitch Roller Trays
abstract: Replacement of the aft compartment brushed drive units and roller trays by a brushless standard with load sensing and a shorter roller pitch, cutting container jams and the handling damage that follows them.

sections.planning_reason: Ground handling reports across sixteen operators show the aft compartment loading system as the largest single source of container damage on the type, at 4.1 damaged containers per 1 000 loads. The brushed drive units stall without warning when a container is out of square and the loader then forces it, damaging both the container and the tray. Brush wear also drives a 1 200 flight hour inspection that operators dislike because it needs the compartment empty. Two operators had begun loading the aft compartment by hand on short turnarounds.
sections.description: The powered drive units are replaced by brushless units with current-based load sensing that stops the drive and lights a fault indication at the loading panel. The loading panel is replaced by a version with the jam indication and a manual override, and the roller trays across the compartment are replaced by trays with a 25 mm shorter roller pitch. The obsolete swaged collar set is deleted from the tray joint in favour of a bolted arrangement.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Make sure that the aft compartment is empty and that the ground service bus is available. Remove the cargo lining panels in zones 133, 142 and 145. CAUTION: THE ROLLER TRAYS ARE HEAVY AND WILL TIP WHEN THE END FASTENERS ARE REMOVED. Do AMM-S-25-50-12-000-018-A to remove the powered drive units and the roller trays. Remove the obsolete swaged collars EN728781-4A from each tray joint and discard them. Install the short-pitch roller trays with the bolted joint arrangement from the kit. Install the brushless drive units and connect the load sensing pair. Re-work the cargo loading system kit D2550120953014 to carry the new controller. Install the left-hand loading panel D2550128614202 with the jam indication and the manual override, and re-label the panel position 46DL. Re-cut the upper cargo lining panel position 9DQ where the new tray fouls it and install the lining panels. Retain the outboard latch kit VAL324542-62 with no change. Do the loading system functional test with a test container, including a deliberate skew to prove the jam detection. Record the embodiment and the revised empty mass.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to SOLANO-30 and SOLANO-34 aircraft from MSN S01046 onward that already carry the freighter hard point provisioning, because the short-pitch tray shares its outer fastener row with the hard point feet. Aircraft below MSN S01046 have a different floor beam standard and cannot take the short-pitch tray without further work.
sections.material_note: Kit K2550-1052-01 contains the drive units, the roller trays, the loading panel and the bolted joint hardware. Lead time is twenty-two weeks and the trays are the long-lead item. The removed drive units are returned to the supplier for credit.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled C-check where the aft compartment can be emptied, or at the operator's discretion.
